newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London static, HSBC up.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London static, HSBC up.

text.p: Hong Kong shares trading in London were becalmed on Tuesday with volume thin and only HSBC Holdings showing any real movement, dealers said.

By 1526 GMT the Hang Seng London Reference Index was 5.34 points higher at 13,459.55. Dealers said HSBC climbed to a high of HK$188-1/2, $1-1/2 above its Hong Kong close, before slipping back to $188.
The Hang Seng fell 189.33 points to 13,454.21 in Hong Kong overnight and dealers said the market's weakness was discouraging investors in Hong Kong shares in London.
"The move in Hong Kong has been a shock. People want to see shares stabilise before they get back into the market," one said.
